statement: For the canonical A1 full-production quadratic symbol on the L=16 torus, take the actual Fourier pairs +/-k and +/-q with k=(pi/8,0,0) and q=2k, six-real per-mode covariance Gamma_j=diag(C_j,C_j), C_j=(a(jk)I_3+M)^-1, and the registered A6/A7 convention. For an antipodal pair at generic wavevector p, the exact pointwise field and derivative syntheses satisfy Gamma_x=2Gamma_p/V, Gamma_v=2p_i^2Gamma_p/V, and K_i(x,x)=S_xS_v^*=0, while K_i(x,y)=2p_i Gamma_p sin(p dot (x-y))/V is nonzero off the diagonal and the coefficient-space cross synthesis is skew. Thus for the final +/-q pair the kernel is 4k_i Gamma_2 sin(2k dot (x-y))/V. The R-149 affine-Gaussian identity proves that its exhaustive full-output, full-reveal absolute endpoint atom has conditional raw owner equal to one half of E[v^*B(W)v|past], which is nonnegative for every strict-past field/current pair and the complete six-row positive Gram B=C_6^*C_6. At that absolute endpoint Vfuture=0, so raw=Pcomp; this atom may be certified with zero source/sextic allocation eta_abs,2=zeta_abs,2=0. The result does not sign the relative secant Pcomp(Z_*)-Pcomp(Z_previous), apply after a nonlocal output projection, close the earlier +/-k root whose future feedback depends on it, or reconstruct the complete R-125/R-063 forest, balanced, returned-low, source, sextic, and relative-owner aggregate.
